implementation.summary: Implemented dependency-free Node.js ESM TODO CLI at ./cli.mjs with add, list, and complete commands. IDs are positive safe integers, stable across processes, and strictly increasing. All validation requirements are implemented: rejects empty/whitespace titles, extra arguments, unknown commands, malformed IDs (0, negative, decimal, scientific notation, non-numeric, unsafe integers), and nonexistent IDs with nonzero exit. Errors never create/modify storage or consume IDs. Completion is repeatable. TODO_FILE isolates stores. Ready for acceptance testing.
